issues.title: Support detail for orders panel
issues.body:
The `Orders` documents can be quite complex.  While we display a summary for the table view, players need to be able to expand the item to view all of the detail.

So, we need to use the `detailPanel` capability of `material table`.  Once we've got the detail to display some plain old message fields, we'll move onto using `JSON-Editor` to render the detail.

Hmm, there's a chance the JSON-configuration will look different for different templates.  If that's the case, I guess we may need to return the contents of a method, rather than plain HTML.
